checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the Washing Machine and place the laundry basket beside it.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot can navigate to specific objects (can_navigate, can_detect_objects). It uses the Nav2 action '/navigate_to_pose' to move to the location of the washing machine.
The robot has manipulation capabilities (can_place, can_manipulate). It uses the MoveIt2 action '/move_action' to move the held object to the target pose next to the washing machine and release it.

constraints: Robot is single-arm only; cannot use two hands.
Robot cannot climb stairs (cannot_climb), assumes flat floor navigation.
